learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn how to talk about things that happened yesterday using Was and Were!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: When we talk about something that is already finished or happened in the past we use Was and Were.
We use Was for one person animal or thing. It takes the place of Is and Am. I was happy yesterday.
We use Were when we talk about many people or things. It takes the place of Are. They were playing outside.

fun_activity.title: 📅 The Yesterday Game
fun_activity.instructions: Tell your parents two things you did yesterday. Start your sentences with I was.

quick_recap: ⭐ Was and Were are used to talk about the past.
⭐ Was is used for singular nouns and pronouns.
⭐ Were is used for plural nouns and pronouns.
